title: Buried and bulk synergistic engineering enables high-performance inverted 2D/3D perovskite solar cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,3740-3749
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00156K, Paper
Zonglong Song, Yu Zou, Yuping Gao, Xingbang Gao, Liu Yang, Hang Liu, Yuting Ma, Rui Wang, Ziyang Hu, Yongsheng Chen, Baomin Xu, Yongsheng Liu
A buried and bulk synergistic strategy was developed to improve perovskite film quality. Optimizing the buried interface using FuMACl and bulk using (DFP)2PbI4 seeds led to a champion photovoltaic efficiency of 26.03% and a fill factor of 86.79%.
